scraped.scraped_description: Cybersecurity for Democracy is a research-based effort to expose online threats to our social fabric – and recommend how to counter them. We are part of the Center for Cybersecurity at NYU.

name: Cybersecurity for Democracy
tagline: A multi-university center for problem-driven research and research-driven policy
sdg_alignment: SDG 16: Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
news_articles: Guardian: 'How researchers are fighting platform manipulation' (2024)
Wired: 'Inside NYU's Cybersecurity for Democracy Lab' (2023)
Reuters: 'Academic researchers challenge tech platforms on transparency' (2024)
TechCrunch: 'NYU center releases tools for election security' (2023)
academic_citations: Cited in 200+ peer-reviewed publications on platform transparency and election security
Google Scholar: 2,400+ citations of center research
awards: Privacy Enhanced Technology Symposium (PETS) awards - 2 researchers

policy_outcomes.description: Research on transparency mechanisms informed DSA legislation
Provided input to European Commission public consultation on researcher access to platform data under DSA

outcome_methodology: Mixed methods including quantitative platform analysis, policy document review, and stakeholder interviews
preregistered_studies: OSF registration for 2024 election integrity study
published_performance_metrics: Center publishes annual research impact reports documenting policy citations and media coverage
documented_limitations: Platform data access constraints limit real-time analysis
Geographic focus primarily on US and EU contexts
failure_modes: Platform API changes disrupted data collection pipelines (2023)
Delayed policy implementation of research recommendations
curation_criteria: Research prioritizes policy-relevant questions with direct stakeholder engagement; peer review process for all publications
contributor_governance: Multi-university consortium with faculty steering committee; open contribution guidelines for tools and datasets
disparity_tracking: Center tracks research outcomes across geographic regions and demographic groups; publishes equity assessments in annual reports
community_ownership: Collaborative governance with partner institutions; researcher and policymaker advisory boards
elections_used_in: 2024 US Presidential Election - platform monitoring research
2024 EU Parliamentary Elections - content moderation analysis
